name: Scenic Stillness Butter Yellow Short Kurta
description:
Product Description: 
Scenic Stillness is crafted in a soft, breathable fabric with a gentle, muted finish that feels light and effortless. The relaxed-fit silhouette is highlighted with a serene landscape embroidery, featuring a subtle pop of colour that brings the design to life while keeping the overall look minimal. Finished with a clean mandarin collar, it reflects calm, modern elegance.
Styling:Pair it with straight-fit jeans for a contemporary festive look or style it with classic ethnic bottoms for a timeless appeal. Complete the look with minimal leather footwear or mojaris for an easy, refined finish.
Material: 100% CottonColor: Yellow
Model Size: M
